name: Jade Medallion
change: Portrait in a carved, translucent dark green nephrite jade boulder with low-relief reeds and a hairline gold bezel.
good: Your jade idea: reads as real polished stone, not cartoon; the reed carving ties it to the river; the boulder shape sits naturally in the corner.
watch: The boulder is fairly large next to the bars; the jade texture is busy at small size.

name: Verde Antico
change: Portrait in an oval cameo carved into dark green marble with white veining, ringed by a gilded stone laurel wreath.
good: The most classical and legendary; the laurel wreath carries over the portrait ring you liked in Ringed Dial; marble keeps the green palette.
watch: The eye toggle came out as a tab sticking out of the status tray's right edge.

name: Kintsugi Stone
change: Portrait in a dark river stone cracked and mended with pale gold seams.
good: Organic stone with gold that has a story (broken and mended), very fitting for survival; the simplest silhouette of the ten.
watch: The seam was supposed to run on into the panel's edge and did not; one timed status (the tent) was dropped, so it shows 12 of 13.

name: Geode Hollow
change: Portrait inside a split geode: rough grey rock, banded agate and a ring of dark green crystals.
good: The most striking natural object; the crystal ring frames the face like a halo without any glow; clearly legendary-treasure in mood.
watch: The grey rock and agate bands are the busiest texture of the set; the water droplet status came out red.

name: Gold in Quartz
change: Portrait in a block of dark smoky quartz threaded with natural gold veins that continue into the panel edges.
good: Gold appears the way it does in nature, threaded through dark crystal, so it feels found rather than applied; the dark smoky quartz keeps it moody; compact.
watch: The eye toggle floats outside the tray on the right; the sharp crystal edges are busy at small size.

name: Mossbound Ruin
change: Portrait framed by a weathered fragment of an ancient carved granite ring with moss, a small fern and lichen.
good: The strongest 'legendary ruin' mood: a fragment of an ancient monument reclaimed by moss; the moss stays small and crisp as asked.
watch: The ring has carved letter-like marks that could read as writing; green moss on a green world adds texture; the art starts a little away from the screen corner.

name: Rootbound
change: A dark stone medallion gripped by ancient grey tree roots that run a short way along the screen edges.
good: Feels ancient and alive, as if the HUD grew into the corner; grey roots avoid the rejected brown-wood look; roots along both screen edges anchor it.
watch: The roots spread across the corner and down the left edge, adding weight where other UI may sit; the root texture is busy.

name: Stag Crown
change: Portrait in a dark stone ring with a pair of real weathered stag antlers rising behind it like a crown.
good: A strong, noble silhouette that says hunter and lord of the wild; the antlers are realistic, not stylised.
watch: The tallest of the ten, and it could read as a hunting trophy; the antlers add height without holding any information.

name: Obsidian Edge
change: Portrait in volcanic obsidian with knapped, blade-like flaked edges and a polished face.
good: Dark, primal and dramatic; the polished face around the portrait reads well.
watch: The flaking came out as flat polished facets, close to the faceted low-poly look rejected for the world's art; it reads more like a cut gem than knapped stone.

name: River Nacre
change: Portrait ringed with iridescent river mother-of-pearl and small freshwater pearls, set in dark river stone.
good: The most precious and the most specific to the river (mussel shell and freshwater pearls); the sheen catches light without glowing; a clean round silhouette.
watch: The eye toggle sticks out from the tray's right edge; the iridescence may read as jewellery more than survival.
